rules.title: Rules
rules.content:
## Before the Game Starts

A long time ago in the sleepy town of Ravenswood Bluff, during a hellish thunderstorm, on the stroke of midnight... you hear a scream. Rushing to the Town Square to investigate, you find your beloved Storyteller, myself, has been murdered... impaled on the hour hand of the clocktower, blood dripping onto the cobblestones below. You assume that this is the work of a Demon, and you are correct—a Demon that kills by night and takes on human form by day.

You are about to receive either a red or blue token. If blue, you are good. If red, you are evil. The aim of the game if you are good is to find and execute the Demon. If the Demon dies, good wins. The aim of the game if you are evil is to destroy the town. If just two players are left alive, evil wins.

The game is split into two phases: a day phase and a night phase. During the day, you talk. You will each have a secret identity, a character on the list. Generally, the good players share whatever they know and attempt to find out who is who. Most good players will be telling the truth, but some have an incentive to lie. If you are evil, you should definitely be lying! It is best to pick a good character to pretend to be, spreading as much false information as possible.

During the night, everybody closes their eyes. I will wake some players so that they can use their ability or gain some type of information. At night, I will be silent, but communicate using the following signals: _(Demonstrate the following as you talk.)_

* 2 taps on your shoulder or your knee means **EYES OPEN**
* This means **EYES CLOSED**
* This means **YES** and this means **NO**
* This means **GOOD** and this means **EVIL**
* This means **0, 1, 2, 3** and so on
* To choose a player at night, just point to them like **THIS**

Most of you will die. This is a good thing! In Ravenswood Bluff, death is not the end. Some players may even want to die, as they gain information when they do. If you are dead, you still participate in the game, you may still talk, and you still win or lose when your team wins or loses.

There is a lot of information in this game. However, some of it might be wrong. If you are drunk or poisoned, you have no ability, but I will pretend that you do. I am allowed to lie to you—any information that you get may be incorrect, but you will not know if you are drunk or poisoned. For example, if you are the Drunk, you drew a different character token out of the bag and only I know that you are actually the Drunk. Or, if the Poisoner poisons you, you may still wake at night to use your ability, but it won't work.

## Four Rules

This can be a lot of information to take in at once, so to keep things simple, there are only four things you need to remember:

1) **You may say whatever you want at any time.** This is a talking game. You can talk publicly with the group or have private conversations, it is up to you.

2) **No peeking.** Please keep your character token a secret, and never look into the Grimoire, as it contains all the game characters. If you see something you shouldn't, it will spoil the fun.

3) **Ask me any questions you need to.** If you get confused, or don't understand how your character works, or don't understand how the character that you are pretending to be works, or if something happens at night that you don't understand, or you just need some strategy advice... whatever it is, please ask. I'm neutral, and my job is to help you understand the rules and have fun playing. Let me know when you have a question, and we can talk in private so that nobody knows what question you asked.

4) **Play nice.** This is a game about deception and trickery, so please treat others with respect and consideration. Kill with grace, and die with dignity.

## Before the First Nomination

**I am about to call for nominations.**
To nominate a player, simply say who. For example: "I nominate Bob." When a player is nominated, everyone votes on whether or not to execute them. For example: I will put my arm out like this (point to Bob), and say "Votes for Bob, starting now." I move my hand in a clockwise direction (demonstrate this) and if your hand is up when I get to you, that's a vote, and if your hand is down, that's not a vote.

Each day, you may vote for as few or as many players as you wish, and whoever has the most votes is executed. This player needs a vote tally of at least 50% of the living players or no execution occurs. On a tie, neither player is executed.

If you die, you are still a major part of the game. You still talk, and you still close your eyes during the night time. Most importantly, you still win or lose with your team. In fact, the game is usually decided by the votes and opinions of the dead players. When you die, you lose your character ability, you may no longer nominate, and you have only one vote for the rest of the game, so use it wisely.

tour.title: Tours
tour.seen_hint: Tours you have seen are switched on. Switch one off to see it again.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: This is the guided tour. You can mark any tour as seen or unseen in Preferences, under Tours.

script_search.title: Choose a script
script_search.body: Search for a script by name, paste a URL or upload your own.

advanced_search.body: Refine your search here by author, name or included or excluded roles.

player_count.title: How many players?
player_count.body: Set the number of players. The edit button lets you enter their names.

random_roles.title: Random roles
random_roles.body: Let the Grimoire pick roles for you, with the right number of each type.

token_selector.title: Pick the roles
token_selector.body: Tap roles to put them in the bag. The counts show what this player count needs.

travellers.title: Travellers
travellers.body: Add Travellers for players who arrive late or leave early.

npcs.title: Fabled and Loric
npcs.body: Add any Fabled or Loric this game uses.

start_setup.title: Start
start_setup.body: Choose how the seats are laid out, then move on to the draw phase.

handout_panel.body: Pick how roles reach your players. You can change this later.

call_up.body: Call each player up one at a time. You tap on their seat, they tap on the token bag to see their role.

pass.body: Hand the device round the circle. Each player draws their role, then passes it on. Your PIN locks the Grimoire so nobody can peek.

phones.body: Players join the town on their own phone. Once everyone is in, you send each player their role.

change_mode.body: Tap here to pick a different way of handing out roles.

invite_players.body: Open this to get players onto their phones.

set_up_seats.body: Assign player names to seats, manually assign roles to seats (travellers for instance). Both are optional.

names.body: Tap a name to put that player in the next empty seat. Tap a seat to clear it.

add_names.body: Tap here to add names if you don't see any below.

roles.body: Tap a role, then a seat, to assign that role to the seat. Handy for travellers.

skip_draw.body: Give every empty seat a random role and skip the draw.

start_game.body: Once every seat has a role, start the game.

handout_panel.body: Every seat already has its role from the draft, and the bluffs are already set.

set_up_seats.body: Add player names to the seats here if you like. This is optional.

start_game.body: Players already know their roles, so you can jump straight into the first night.

town_code.body: Players type this code to join your town. Tap the pencil to change it.

join_link.body: Players can scan this to join straight away, or you can copy or share the link.

connected_players.body: Players appear here as they join, with their seat number once they have one. Tap the cross to remove someone.

send_tokens.body: Send each player their role. If not everyone has joined yet, you'll be asked to confirm first.

good_player.title: A good player
good_player.body: This player is on the good team. Tap a player to open their menu. Drag to move them.

evil_player.title: An evil player
evil_player.body: This player is on the evil team. Each token's artwork shows which team that player is on.

seat_menu.title: Player menu
seat_menu.body: Show Fullscreen, Add Reminders, Mark as Dead, Swap, Change Alignment and open the tools menu. Tap outside the menu to close it.
seat_menu.body_evil: Show Fullscreen, Add Reminders, Add a Bluff Reminder, Mark as Dead, Swap, Change Alignment and open the tools menu. Tap outside the menu to close it.

add.title: Add
add.body: Add demon bluffs, extra roles and reminder tokens.

night_order.body: Opens the night order pane which guides you through who to wake each night.

phase.title: Day and night
phase.body: Move the game forward to the next day or night.

view.title: View
view.body: Rearrange seats, open the Spy view, read the game history or change the background.

town.title: Town
town.body: Open the Town view on a separate public display to show players who's alive/dead, has ghost vote, and do final reveal at the end of the game.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.body: Change token sizes, what is shown on each player, and more.

gr_details.body: Hide every role in the Grimoire, so you can turn the screen round without giving anything away. Tap it again to show them.

gr_lock.title: Lock tokens
gr_lock.body: Lock the tokens in place so they can't be dragged by accident. They lock by themselves when the game ends.

gr_notes.body: Your own notes for the whole game. Notes about one player go in that player's token menu.

gr_timer.body: Set a countdown for the day, or run a stopwatch. Once it's set, tap the time to pause it or carry on.

gr_music.title: Music
gr_music.body: Play your own music files in the background. Add sound effects too, and set them to play when the timer reaches 1:00, 0:30 or 0:00.

gr_type_icons.body: Hold this down to show a letter on each token for its type: Townsfolk, Outsider, Minion or Demon.

town_composition.title: Town composition
town_composition.body: The script's name, then how many Townsfolk, Outsiders, Minions and Demons this many players should have, each in its own colour. On smaller screens, tap the banner to see them.

town_state.title: Town state
town_state.body: The person icon shows the number of living players. It turns yellow at 4 and red at 3 or fewer. The suitcase denotes the number of travellers. The skull is dead players. The hand shows how many votes are remaining, ghost votes included. It turns red when there aren't enough votes left to exceed the current on-the-block total. The tick shows the number of votes required to lift the current person off the block.

end_game.title: End game
end_game.body: Declare the winner when the game is over.

night_cards.body: Open the Cards menu to show a player a card, or make your own.

show_role.title: Show any role
show_role.body: Pick any role on the script, even one not in play, then tap expand to show it fullscreen. Roles in play are marked with a dot.

placed_reminders.title: Placed reminders
placed_reminders.body: This role's reminders in the Grimoire, with the player each one is on. Tap one to show that player's role fullscreen.

unplaced_reminders.title: Unplaced reminders
unplaced_reminders.body: The number is how many of this role's reminders are not in the Grimoire yet. Tap to see them, then drag one onto a player.

pref_display.body: Fullscreen hides the browser's own bars. Official icons uses the official TPI icons instead of community created artwork. Draw animation shuffles through roles before a drawn token is revealed.

pref_sizes.body: Change how big tokens and reminders are. The link button keeps the ratio between the two sizes the same.

pref_token_info.body: Choose what each token shows: the leaves for reminders, night order and setup instructions, its ability, how and when a dead player died, and its place in the night order. Skip dead lets the night order pass over dead players.

pref_player_info.body: Choose what each player's name badge shows: their name, pronouns and seat number.

pref_footer.title: Help and more
pref_footer.body: About shows what's new in each version and lets you clear the cache. FAQ answers common questions. Tours lets you see any tour again. Discord opens our Discord server for help and feedback.

tok_header.body: The pencil renames this player and sets their pronouns. The bin removes this player and their role from the Grimoire.

tok_role.body: Show puts this role fullscreen for a player to see. Notes keeps your own notes on this player. Wiki opens the role's wiki page.

tok_jinxes.body: How this role interacts with the other roles in play.

tok_tools.body: Pick a role from the list. Become turns this player into that role. Gain Ability gives them that role's ability as well as their own (think Philosopher).

tok_notify.body: Get an alert when this player is nominated, nominates someone, dies or is chosen at night. For deaths, choose day, night or both. Add a note to show with the alert, and choose whether it fires every time or just once.

usr_favourites.body: Scripts you've starred on the setup screen. Tap one to load it. Add coloured tags to sort them, then tap a tag to filter the list.

usr_friends.body: People you play with. Their names are ready to pick when you seat players, so you don't have to type them each time.

usr_games.body: Games you've saved from the Game menu. Load one on the setup screen to carry on where you left off.

usr_homebrew.body: Homebrew scripts you've added to search. Tap one to load it, or tap the cross to remove it from search.

usr_logout.body: Log out of your Discord account on this device.
